en: Jumper learned to breakdance. In simulation.
zh: Jumper 螃蟹机器人学会了霹雳舞，在仿真中。

en: Robot Mode: the whole routine runs live, on the beat, in your browser.
zh: Robot Mode：整套霹雳舞在浏览器里按节拍实时运行。

en: Seven new Jumper policies. Trained by us, open source.
zh: 七个全新的 Jumper 策略，由我们训练并开源。

en: In the game, press B: six moves, six trained policies.
zh: 在游戏里按 B：六个动作，六个训练好的策略。

en: The 720 and the back flip, slowed down. Both also run live in Robot Mode.
zh: 放慢的 720 跳转和后空翻，两者也能在 Robot Mode 里实时运行。

en: Beat the Rust Tyrant, and the whole town watches you break.
zh: 击败锈蚀暴君，全镇围观你跳霹雳舞。
